images.dark_cozy_blanket: A dark cozy bedroom at night with only a tiny soft glow from a night light, a thick blanket on a bed, calm and safe, nobody present.
images.big_city_old: A huge ancient city on a river plain with many houses and walls under a cloudy sky, viewed from a distance, nobody visible.
images.road_leaving_city: A dusty road leading away from a big ancient city toward the sea coast at sunset, a single small bundle on a rock by the road, nobody present.
images.ship_harbor_loaded: An old wooden sailing ship heavily loaded with sacks and barrels in a small harbor, calm evening light, nobody present.
images.ship_stormy_sea: An old wooden sailing ship on big rolling waves in the open grey sea, tilting a little, dramatic but not scary, family film style.
images.gentle_whale_deep: A huge gentle friendly blue whale swimming peacefully in the deep dark blue ocean, soft light rays from above, calm and protective.
images.three_darkness: A deep dark ocean at night under a moonless sky, with a faint soft glow deep beneath the water, mysterious but calm and hopeful.
images.beach_dawn_whale: A quiet sandy beach at dawn, gentle waves, a big friendly whale tail disappearing into the calm sea, soft golden light.
images.gourd_plant_shade: A large gourd plant with big broad green leaves growing over a sandy shore, creating cool shade, sunny day, peaceful.
images.city_lanterns_joy: A big ancient city at dusk with hundreds of warm lanterns glowing on every roof, joyful and peaceful, viewed from a hill.
